6890880.title: Regime-Preserving Bootstrap for FX Fair-Value Models
6890880.abstract: Two regime-aware bootstrap resamplers (Regime-Uniform, Regime-Markov) for FX fair-value strategies (BEER, FEER, PPP), validated against naive baselines on three currency pairs with B = 1999 replicates. Regime-Markov reduces bootstrap Sharpe loss by 1.3× vs. Regime-Uniform and 4.6× vs. IID. The Section 11.7 stationarity gate is passed across all Sinkhorn caps 0.5%–10%.

6700099.title: Auditing ICT/PO3 FX Heuristics: An Independent Empirical Test of the Daily Swing Framework
6700099.abstract: Independent empirical test of two PO3-inspired ICT trading strategies (Daily Swing Framework, Composite) on six instruments over 18 years of M30 data. Result: no risk-adjusted edge under realistic retail transaction costs. Daily Swing delivers Sharpe −3.50 on EURUSD; retail-level spread and slippage erase the rule edge that exists in frictionless backtests.
